description: Live variant of clean-consistency-ctx-param: a new Go client method takes ctx as a parameter next to sibling methods that store ctx on the struct. The only recorded candidate proposes matching the stored-field pattern; that pattern contradicts the Go context package's documented guidance (do not store Contexts inside a struct type). The deterministic replay pins the plumbing with the recorded refutation; the live tree makes the claim-validator (and the finders) face the trap for real, and the clean PR must approve with nothing posted.

finding.failure_scenario: No runtime misbehavior; the client mixes two context-plumbing patterns, so a future reader must check per method which one applies.
